newsitem.title: UK: Littlewoods says may re-open Sears talks.
newsitem.headline: Littlewoods says may re-open Sears talks.

text.p: The Littlewoods Organisation said on Wednesday it was negotiating with retailer Sears Plc about reopening talks to buy Sears' Freemans mail order business, after rival N.Brown Group Plc withdrew.
Sears later confirmed it was reopening talks with Littlewoods, after direct mail order group N. Brown said it was unable to proceed.

Littlewoods had originally agreed to buy Freemans from Sears, but withdrew when Sears started talking to other potential buyers after its Littlewoods's deal was referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
The retail-to-football pools group said it would re-enter talks if Sears guaranteed exclusivity.
Sears decided to sell Freemans as part of a major restructuring, which includes plans for a 410 million stg payout to placate shareholders dissatisfied with the retailer's poor profit performance.
